messages:
maya: ok team — launching a small peer-recognition pilot called PeerShelf next month. need to coordinate kit assembly, desk-drops, and remote shipping. timeline: kits must ship by 2024-04-15. who can own: logistics, announcement, and nom form?

samir: I can take logistics. need final headcount + shipping addresses by 4/8. do we have a PO or budget cap? :moneybag:

kelly: budget approved — $8 per kit plus shipping. estimate 500 ppl max. i'll share a quick budget spreadsheet.

jonathan: I can draft the Slack announcement and a short email. will post a 2-line nomination form. want tone casual + inclusive. sample: `Hey team — nominate someone for a tiny PeerShelf award: one sentence on why`.

maya: perfect. @samir — can you confirm whether we can use our existing vendor for bulk desk stickers + enamel pin, or do we need new quotes?

samir: vendor said they can do enamel pin + postcard combo, lead time 10 business days. will ping for a quote today and upload to shared drive.

kelly: adding note: remote folks get equivalent care package via tracked shipping. customs forms handled by finance if value > $50 per country. pls flag any outliers.

mia: (reacting) :thumbsup:  

jonathan: draft announcement below — open to edits:
```
Hey Redwood — launching PeerShelf, a micro-recognition drop. Nominate a teammate who made your week (one sentence). Winners get a little desk token + handwritten note. Nominations close 4/10.
Submit: <short-form-link>
```

maya: looks good. can we add a line about anonymous nominations being allowed and winners contacted before public shoutouts?

jonathan: updated. will post on 4/11 morning if we have the form ready.

samir: quote in. cost looks like $6.50 per kit + $3 avg shipping domestic. uploading `vendor-quotes/peershelf-q1.pdf`.

peopleops-bot: Inventory check: enamel pins on hand = 120, postcards = 300, packing cards = 200.

kelly: we should cap ez-ship requests to those outside the US/EU to avoid surprise VAT. Finance ok with handling exceptions case-by-case.

tia: quick ops Q — who owns handwritten notes? can we surface a volunteer sign-up for writing 100 notes? happy to coordinate a volunteer scribe rota.

maya: love that. tia please run the scribe sign-up + pickup times. i'll own pickup from vendor and consolidation at HQ on 4/12-4/14.

samir: logistics checklist I'm tracking:
- confirm qty by 4/8
- vendor delivery 4/10
- packing dates 4/12-4/14
- ship desks 4/15
- remote ship by 4/16
I'll attach checklist to the shared doc.

jonathan: can someone add the nomination form link + a one-line FAQ: "How are winners chosen?" -> peer votes + ops selection for diversity of teams.

maya: yes add FAQ. also add opt-out for people who don't want recognition packages.

kelly: timeline looks good. i'll create a cost summary and get PO number by 4/6.

tia: volunteer sign-up created: <signup-link>. adding time slots for 4/12 afternoon and 4/13 morning for note-writing.

samir: heads-up — packaging requires a small sticker that says "PeerShelf". vendor needs final art by 4/3. can someone own the art?

jonathan: @maya i can ask design to do a simple sticker mock by EOD tomorrow.

maya: thanks. last items: who will handle comms to winners and social post? @jonathan for winners DM, @maya for social post approval.

kelly: noted. can we add a simple metric to track: nominations count, teams represented, shipping success rate? ops wants a postmortem.

maya: agreed — add to Redwood Console ops tracker under "culture/pilot/peershelf".

jonathan: i'll post draft announcement in #general on 2024-04-11 10:00 PT unless anyone objects.

tia: no objections. excited! :party: 

peopleops-bot: Reminder set: collect final headcount on 2024-04-08 09:00 UTC.
